description: Connect a hostname whose DNS stays at another provider to a work of the account — 'connect shop.my-company.com to my shop'. Without target_kind it shows the account's start page. If ownership must be proven first, the error names the TXT record; afterwards the user sets a CNAME to cname_target.

target_id.description: The id of the work for target_kind.
